\begin{theorem}[Exact influence of even majority]
\lean{FABL.totalInfluence_evenMajority_exact}
\label{FABL.totalInfluence_evenMajority_exact}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.BooleanFunction, FABL.BooleanFunction.toReal, FABL.IsMajorityFunction, FABL.totalInfluence, FABL.totalInfluence_evenMajority_eq_oddMajority, FABL.totalInfluence_majority_odd}
\difficulty{1}
Let $m$ be a natural number, and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the
$(2m+2)$-dimensional cube whose value agrees with the sign of the sum of the input
coordinates whenever that sum is nonzero. Then its total influence is $\displaystyle
(2m+1)\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Even majority total influence error]
\lean{FABL.evenMajorityTotalInfluenceError}
\label{FABL.evenMajorityTotalInfluenceError}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.BooleanFunction, FABL.BooleanFunction.toReal, FABL.totalInfluence}
Let $m$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the cube of dimension
$2m+2$. Its even majority total influence error is
$\operatorname{Inf}(f)-\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sqrt{2m+2}$, where $\operatorname{Inf}(f)$ denotes
the total influence of $f$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Even majority influence decomposition]
\lean{FABL.totalInfluence_evenMajority_eq_main_add_error}
\label{FABL.totalInfluence_evenMajority_eq_main_add_error}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.BooleanFunction, FABL.BooleanFunction.toReal, FABL.evenMajorityTotalInfluenceError, FABL.totalInfluence}
\difficulty{1}
For every natural number $m$ and every Boolean function $f$ on the $(2m+2)$-dimensional
cube, the total influence of its real-valued sign representation is the sum of
$\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sqrt{2m+2}$ and the error defined as the difference between that total
influence and this term.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Negative half power as a reciprocal square root]
\lean{FABL.evenArity_rpow_neg_one_half}
\label{FABL.evenArity_rpow_neg_one_half}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
For every nonnegative integer $m$, $(2m+2)^{-1/2}=1/\sqrt{2m+2}$.
\end{theorem}
